boards.title: Career URLs or board tokens
boards.description: Company career / job-board URLs, or ATS tokens/slugs. The Actor auto-detects Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters and Recruitee from the URL. You can also write greenhouse:stripe, lever:palantir, ashby:linear, workable:huggingface, smartrecruiters:BoschGroup or recruitee:bunq. A bare slug (e.g. stripe) is probed against every supported ATS.

companyDomains.title: Company domains to discover
companyDomains.description: Optional helper: company websites (e.g. stripe.com or https://openai.com). The Actor looks up which ATS the company uses (slug probe + careers-page scan) and then scrapes those boards. Use Discover only to list the ATS without scraping jobs.

discoverOnly.title: Discover only (do not scrape jobs)
discoverOnly.description: If enabled, only return which ATS / board token each company domain uses. Nothing is charged except the tiny start fee.

keyword.title: Keyword filter
keyword.description: Keep jobs whose title, department, team, location or description contains all of these words (case-insensitive).

location.title: Location filter
location.description: Keep jobs whose location contains this text (e.g. London, Remote, United States).

department.title: Department filter
department.description: Keep jobs whose department or team contains this text (e.g. Engineering, Marketing).

remoteOnly.title: Remote only
remoteOnly.description: Keep only jobs flagged as remote (or whose workplace type is remote).

maxJobs.title: Max jobs in total (optional)
maxJobs.description: Hard cap on the number of job listings scraped (and charged) in this run.

includeDescription.title: Include job description
includeDescription.description: Include full HTML and plain-text descriptions. Turn off for a faster, lighter listing of titles and metadata. On SmartRecruiters this also avoids an extra request per job.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel HTTP requests to the official job-board APIs.
